You will enable clients to realize the full potential of Meta's Business Messaging Platform and AI as a customer engagement solution. This role will primarily serve mid and large-sized clients in APAC.

The ideal candidate will have extensive Enterprise and technical design sales experience, preferably in driving growth and consumption for SaaS solutions, especially in a multi product, consultative sales environment, revenue-oriented role. The role requires prospecting, pipeline development, executive engagement, technical design and closing business with our key clients, by presenting products packaged as the right business solutions based on individual business needs, joint client architecture workshops, and driving execution through internal cross functional teams and external partners. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. Description

About Amazon Web Services Since 2006, Amazon Web Services has been the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud. AWS has been continually expanding its services to support virtually any workload, and it now has more than 240 fully featured services for compute, storage, databases, networking, analytics, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), mobile, security, hybrid, media, and application development, deployment, and management from 105 Availability Zones within 33 geographic regions, with announced plans for 18 more Availability Zones and 6 more AWS Regions in Malaysia, Mexico, New Zealand, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Thailand. Millions of customers—including the fastest-growing startups, largest enterprises, and leading government agencies—trust AWS to power their infrastructure, become more agile, and lower costs. To learn more about AWS, visit aws.amazon.com.
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

AWS Hong Kong is transforming how enterprises adopt AI, and we need a Business Design Specialist who can bridge the gap between executive vision and technical execution. While our customers are excited about GenAI possibilities, they struggle to translate business challenges into actionable AI solutions. This role exists to serve as a pre-sales consultant who uncovers transformation opportunities, designs agentic AI-enabled business processes from the user perspective, and delivers concrete requirements that our technical teams can implement.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Deliver & Who You'll Work With

- Your key deliverables include business requirements documents, agentic AI process designs showing current vs. future state workflows, prioritized use case portfolios with ROI quantification, and comprehensive handoff packages.
- You'll collaborate closely with Solutions Architects (SA) and AI SSO specialists—you focus on what to build from the business perspective; they determine how to build technically.
- You'll also work with account teams, Training & Certification, and partner ecosystem members to ensure seamless customer experiences.
- You'll create and qualify the pipeline that drives revenue. Your success metrics include conversion rates from workshop to committed projects, pipeline influenced, and time-to-commit acceleration. By delivering better-qualified opportunities with clear business cases, you enable faster sales cycles and larger deal sizes—demonstrating measurable revenue influence through your consultative approach and design expertise.

A day in the life
You'll spend your time engaging C-suite executives in consultative discovery sessions, analyzing their business processes to identify where agentic AI can drive value, and facilitating multi-day workshops that generate prioritized use cases. A typical week might include: conducting a discovery session with a bank's COO to understand their operational challenges, designing a 2-day ideation workshop for a retail company's business users, delivering that workshop to 50-100 participants using tools like Quick Suite and Kiro, and then packaging the outputs—business requirements documents, process design specifications, and use case portfolios—into handoff materials for our Solutions Architects and SSO specialists to execute.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

- 6+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience

Overview

As an Azure Solution Specialist, you will be responsible for driving Azure, Data, AI, and Modernization growth across a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will engage business and technology leaders to identify transformational opportunities, build executive-level business cases, and help customers realize the full value of Microsoft Cloud and AI investments. You will lead a cross-functional virtual team of sales, technical, partner, and services resources to accelerate customer adoption of Azure-based solutions, including Agentic AI, Unified Data Platforms, and application modernization initiatives. Success in this role requires strong executive presence, business acumen, technical credibility, and the ability to orchestrate complex engagements that deliver meaningful business impact and long-term customer value.

Responsibilities

Drive Executive Engagement and Vision Creation - Establish trusted relationships with business and technology decision-makers, creating executive alignment around Microsoft Cloud and AI solutions. Develop compelling transformation visions that inspire customer commitment and influence long-term strategic investments.
Accelerate Growth Through Partner Ecosystems - Collaborate closely with strategic partners, Global System Integrators (GSIs), and priority ISVs to co-sell integrated solutions, unlock new opportunities, and deliver measurable business outcomes for customers.
Develop Business Cases and Win Competitive Deals - Build compelling business cases, solution proposals, and commercial strategies that demonstrate tangible business value. Leverage Microsoft programs, incentives, and offers to negotiate, close, and expand strategic opportunities while effectively differentiating against competitors.
Drive AI and Agentic Transformation - Help customers accelerate their AI transformation journey by identifying, shaping, and executing high-impact opportunities across Agentic AI, Data Platforms, Analytics, and Application Modernization, guiding projects from ideation through production deployment and measurable business value realization.
Lead Complex Strategic Sales Pursuits - Orchestrate large-scale, multi-million-dollar cloud, data, AI, and modernization engagements by leading virtual teams across sales, technical, industry, services, partner, licensing, and legal stakeholders to achieve successful customer outcomes.
Deliver Sales Excellence and Business Performance - Consistently exceed revenue, Azure consumption, and strategic solution targets through disciplined opportunity management, pipeline development, accurate forecasting, and execution excellence.
Champion the Voice of the Customer - Act as a trusted advocate for customers by sharing market insights, customer feedback, and industry best practices to influence Microsoft product innovation, go-to-market strategies, and solution development.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field;
3-5 years of enterprise technology sales experience, with a proven track record of leading and closing large-scale cloud transformation engagements.
Experience driving complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving C-level executives, business decision-makers, technical leaders, partners, and system integrators.
Strong understanding of cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including Infrastructure Migration, Data Platforms, AI solutions, and Application Modernization.
Proven ability to develop executive business cases, influence strategic customer decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes through technology transformation.
Experience leading virtual teams and orchestrating resources across sales, technical, services, partner, licensing, and legal organizations to successfully close strategic opportunities.
